summary: Narrow steep lane with houses 2-3 m from the kerb; no room to stop.

best_section.where: Mervyn Grove, upper flatter stretch before the lower slope

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 2-10 m away along the whole stretch.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane edged by fences and trees; no clear ground to pull fully off.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street running to a main road junction.
drivers.convention: No parked-van convention visible; dense housing.

flags: Houses within 10 m of the best section
sun_shade: Heavily tree-shaded, canopy over most of the lane.
